# agent-ui

> React components for AI and agent interfaces, shipped with Cursor rules that tell a coding agent when and how to use each one. Tailwind v4 + shadcn theme tokens, no hardcoded colors.

Install one: `npx shadcn@latest add https://antoshkin.tech/agent-ui/r/<name>.json`. Install all: `npx shadcn@latest add https://antoshkin.tech/agent-ui/r/all.json`.
Each install adds `components/agent-ui/<name>.tsx` and `.cursor/rules/agent-ui-<name>.mdc`.

## Components

- [Prompt Input](https://antoshkin.tech/agent-ui/r/prompt-input.json): Auto-growing prompt composer with send/stop, attachments and a toolbar slot.
- [Message](https://antoshkin.tech/agent-ui/r/message.json): User and assistant turns with a streaming caret and hover actions.
- [Thinking](https://antoshkin.tech/agent-ui/r/thinking.json): Shimmering reasoning label that collapses into "Thought for Ns".
- [Tool Call](https://antoshkin.tech/agent-ui/r/tool-call.json): Collapsible card for one agent tool call: status, arguments, output, error.
- [Approval](https://antoshkin.tech/agent-ui/r/approval.json): Human-in-the-loop permission card that collapses into a one-line record.
- [Plan](https://antoshkin.tech/agent-ui/r/plan.json): Ordered steps the assistant proposes, with pending, running, done and failed states.
- [Choice](https://antoshkin.tech/agent-ui/r/choice.json): A question from the assistant with two to five mutually exclusive options.
- [Data Table](https://antoshkin.tech/agent-ui/r/data-table.json): A table for comparisons and tool results inside an assistant answer.
- [Answer Chart](https://antoshkin.tech/agent-ui/r/answer-chart.json): One bar or line series, up to eight points, colored with the primary token.
- [Code Block](https://antoshkin.tech/agent-ui/r/code-block.json): Source or a unified diff in an answer, with a filename and a copy button.
- [Sources](https://antoshkin.tech/agent-ui/r/sources.json): Citations under an answer: title, address and a short excerpt.
- [Artifact](https://antoshkin.tech/agent-ui/r/artifact.json): A file or page card in the thread that opens its contents in a side panel.
- [Context Meter](https://antoshkin.tech/agent-ui/r/context-meter.json): Ring showing context-window token usage, with a warning threshold.
- [Suggestions](https://antoshkin.tech/agent-ui/r/suggestions.json): Staggered starter prompts and follow-up chips.
- [Agent Dock](https://antoshkin.tech/agent-ui/r/agent-dock.json): Floating status dock for a running agent that expands into its step list.

## Full reference

- [llms-full.txt](https://antoshkin.tech/agent-ui/r/llms-full.txt): every agent rule in one file
